name: Wheel of Fortune
overview: The Wheel of Fortune represents the ever-changing cycles of life, reminding you that nothing remains the same forever. It symbolizes destiny, karma, unexpected opportunities, and important turning points. This card encourages embracing change with confidence, trusting that every ending creates space for a new beginning. Whether fortune rises or falls, each experience brings valuable lessons that shape your future.

upright.meaning: The Wheel of Fortune Upright signifies positive change, fortunate opportunities, and destiny working in your favor. Life is moving forward, and events are aligning to bring growth, success, and new possibilities. This card encourages trusting the natural flow of life and taking advantage of opportunities when they appear.
upright.love: In relationships, this card often signals positive changes, unexpected romantic opportunities, reconciliation, or taking a relationship to the next level. Singles may experience a chance meeting that feels destined, while couples may enter a happier phase together.
upright.career: Professionally, the Wheel of Fortune suggests promotions, career advancement, unexpected job offers, business success, or favorable changes in your professional life. Stay prepared because opportunities may appear suddenly.
upright.finance: Financially, this is a fortunate card indicating increased income, profitable investments, financial recovery, or unexpected gains. Continue making wise decisions while appreciating periods of abundance.
upright.health: Health improves gradually through positive lifestyle changes and consistent effort. Recovery, renewed energy, and emotional balance are strongly supported during this period.
upright.spiritual: Spiritually, this card represents karma, divine timing, and trusting the universe's plan. Every experience—positive or challenging—serves your soul's growth and helps you evolve.
upright.advice: Welcome change instead of fearing it. Stay adaptable, recognize opportunities when they arrive, and trust that life is guiding you toward your highest good.

reversed.meaning: The Wheel of Fortune Reversed suggests delays, unexpected setbacks, or feeling that life is moving against you. Challenges may arise due to resisting change or circumstances beyond your control. Remember that difficult cycles are temporary and can become opportunities for growth.
reversed.love: Relationships may experience misunderstandings, emotional distance, or unfortunate timing. Avoid forcing outcomes and allow situations to develop naturally. Patience will help restore harmony.
reversed.career: Career progress may temporarily slow due to delays, workplace changes, or unexpected obstacles. Stay adaptable, continue improving your skills, and avoid giving up during temporary setbacks.
reversed.finance: Financial uncertainty, unexpected expenses, or delayed income may occur. Practice careful budgeting, avoid risky investments, and remain patient until circumstances improve.
reversed.health: Recovery may take longer than expected, or fluctuating energy levels could affect your well-being. Focus on consistency, rest, and healthy routines instead of expecting instant results.
reversed.spiritual: Spiritually, this card reminds you that even difficult experiences serve a purpose. Accept life's natural cycles, trust divine timing, and remember that every challenge offers valuable lessons.
reversed.advice: Don't fight inevitable change. Accept what cannot be controlled, learn from setbacks, and prepare yourself for the next positive cycle that is already beginning.

affirmation: I trust the cycles of life, welcome positive change, and know that every turn of destiny brings new opportunities for growth and success.
